resources.string: Meridian provides spoken feedback so that you can use your device without looking at the screen. Meridian can be helpful for people who have difficulty seeing the screen.

When Meridian is on, it provides spoken feedback so that you can use your device without looking at the screen. Meridian is intended for situations or people who have difficulty seeing the screen.

How to use Meridian
• Swipe right or left to move between items
• Double-tap to activate an item
• Drag 2 fingers to scroll
How to turn off Meridian
1. In Settings, tap Use Meridian. There will be an outline. Double-tap it.
2. On the confirmation message, tap Stop. There will be an outline. Double-tap it.
